description.zh:
该参数用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。参数值由客户端生成，保证在不同请求间唯一。

该参数值由ASCII字符组成，最长不超过64个字符，不能包含非ASCII字符。
description.en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests.

The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

description.zh: 实例的Endpoint ID。可调用DescribeDBInstanceEndpoints查询。
description.en: The endpoint ID of the instance. You can call the DescribeDBInstanceEndpoints operation to query the endpoint ID.
The instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the instance ID.

删除Endpoint中的地址，目前仅支持删除Endpoint的外网地址。如需删除内网地址，可以直接删除Endpoint。
descriptions.en:
### [](#)Supported database engines

MySQL

### [](#)Precautions

You can delete only the public endpoint of each endpoint type from the instance. If you want to delete an internal endpoint of any endpoint type, you can directly delete the type of endpoint.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun rds delete-db-instance-endpoint-address --client-token 6000170000591aed949d0f0000 --db-instance-id rm-0000 --db-instance-endpoint-id ep-0000 --connection-string new0000.mysql.rds.aliyuncs.com --region cn-hangzhou
